primary.title: Earnings recovery is broadening, crude spikes unlikely to derail markets: Anand Rathi
primary.summary: The founder of Anand Rathi Group says Q1FY27 earnings point to a broad-based recovery after a subdued FY26, while historical trends suggest geopolitical oil price spikes are usually temporary. He also weighs in on FCNR deposits, market leadership and the outlook for small-caps.
